item.title: Hong Kong PolyU’s Hefei Hub for Cross-Regional Innovation
item.description: Hong Kong Polytechnic University has launched its Hefei Institute of Technology and Innovation to strengthen cross-regional collaboration in aerospace, biomedical research and technology commercialisation.

item.title: Vietnam-Canada AI-Driven Precision Medicine Collaboration
item.description: Vietnam is exploring collaboration with Canada to leverage AI and genomic data for precision medicine, strengthening healthcare and national innovation, enhancing treatment of rare diseases and advancing digital healthcare.

item.title: Singapore: Advancing AI Fluency with New Centre of Excellence
item.description: Singapore has launched a new AI Centre of Excellence to advance workforce readiness, skills development and significantly strengthen responsible, trusted and ethical AI innovation across the financial sector.

item.title: Malaysia: Strengthening Digital Learning in SJKT Schools
item.description: Malaysia equips 387 Tamil schools with smartboards and digital tools to enhance interactive learning, strengthen digital literacy and support nationwide education modernisation.

item.title: India: AI and Technology Growing Smart Agriculture
item.description: The Indian government is leveraging AI and digital technologies to enhance agricultural productivity, promote sustainability and support farmers with climate-smart, data-driven and innovative solutions.

item.title: Western Australia Expands Innovation Pathways Programme
item.description: Western Australia expands its Innovation Pathways Program with increased grants to strengthen accelerator support, boost entrepreneurial skills and enhance investor capability across the innovation ecosystem.

item.title: The Philippines: iMULA Launch Enhances Smart Access to Agricultural Data
item.description: La Trinidad farmers and local governments are set to benefit from iMULA, a digital platform enhancing agricultural data management, service delivery and technology-driven governance nationwide.

item.title: Hong Kong: AI Partnership Accelerates Smart City Solutions
item.description: Hong Kong Science Park partners with a leading regional tech firm to strategically advance smart city innovation through AI-driven 3D mapping, urban intelligence systems and enhanced public safety solutions.

item.title: Vietnam Launches Southern Cybersecurity Hub to Boost Resilience
item.description: Vietnam has officially launched the NCA southern branch in Ho Chi Minh City to strengthen cybersecurity, protect children and vulnerable groups and support the safe growth of its digital economy.

item.title: Singapore: New Standard for Smart Hospital Infrastructure
item.description: Singapore’s launch of the Healthcare Facility Design Standards (HFDS) modernises hospital development by leveraging technology, digital tools and design innovation to build smarter, faster and more efficient healthcare facilities.
